digest.component_or_area: plan-review criterion T1 (overlay-priorart), web search capability routing
propositions: T1 (blocking plan-review criterion) lost server-side web search capability after Bedrock cutover because provider name 'bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8' does not match prefix 'anthropic' in _anthropic_web_search_capabilities
the capability decision gate used provider-name prefix matching instead of capability registry membership, violating the epic's zero-exceptions rule against prefix-based provider qualification
the loss was silent—no warning logged and provider_provenance.capabilities did not record web access withdrawal, making the degradation unobservable in signed verdicts
T1 now runs on weaker evidence (codebase and model knowledge only) for exactly the plans crossing a bright-line threshold, though graceful degradation prevents hallucinated citations

web access must be guaranteed for T1 on every configured provider, requiring replacement of provider-side-only design with capability-registry-derived routing that supports both native (provider) and local (rebar-side) search tools

the fix moved the decision from anthropic_model.py to capabilities.py, removed prefix matching, added web_access provenance recording ('native'|'local'|'off'), and updated T1 prompt to assert web access as guaranteed rather than optional
